title: BOOKSTORES: How to Read More Books in the Golden Age of Content
summary: A short film by Max Joseph about his anxiety in bookstores and how to read more books amid constant streaming, social media and news. He looks for ways to rebalance his content diet in favor of reading.
why: HN commenters cite it as a thoughtful mini-doc on reading time and frequency in the age of social media.

quote.text: it's an interesting exploration of modern bookstores and the dynamics of reading as a pursuit in the age of social media
